messages.subject: constant objective function values
parts:
Hi all,
I had an issue using RSWAT for discharge calibration. After simulation, it shows constant objective function values.

i was able to at least solve this by saving the SWAT+ executable file in an external HD and performed the simulation in this way. 

If I saved the swat exe in the same PC as the project file, it does not work for me. If you face similar challenge, please try this to see if it works for you.

Good luck

Kingsley
